summary: A 1961 metal-tower lookout on Apache Maid Mountain in the Coconino National Forest, last reported staffed in a 2011 register visit.

facts.design: 14' x 14' metal CL-100 series cab on a 30' metal tower

events.note: Erection planned for fiscal 1960 was deferred to fiscal 1961 because of other regional priorities
Erected by contractor Martin C. Cline; contract completed and accepted April 29, 1961
Register visit report dated September 11, 2011 marks the lookout staffed

evidence.quote: Constructed in 1961, Apache Maid Lookout on the Red Rock Ranger District of the Coconino National Forest is a 14'x14' metal CL-100 series cab on a 30' metal tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1959 newspaper's 8,000-foot figure is a rough press figure. The 1961 construction report (7,300 ft) and the register (7,301 ft) agree with the record's 2225.3 m.

notes_for_editor: Current staffing and public access to the tower itself are unknown. The only staffing evidence is the 2011 register visit report. The Recreation.gov listing is for a separate cabin at the base of the mountain, not the tower, and I did not treat it as tower rental. Two hiker forum threads on hikearizona.com (one saying the tower was staffed, one saying it was padlocked) could not be read (HTTP 403), so they are not used. The 1959 newspaper's 8,000 ft figure is an older press figure and is not reconciled beyond the report and register. No new photos found.
